title: Something Is Here
subtitle: The Star Door Mystery
author: Maria Smith
medium_contract: Connected picture book that works without the companion game

pages.text: Something Is Here
pages.alt: Mia, Tavi and Sol stand together on the tower floor and gaze at the shut Star Door.

pages.text: A Star Rooms adventure
pages.subtext:
Written by Maria Smith

Book 1 of 4 · Review edition 2.0.0
Ages 3–5 · Read, point, trace, listen and play
pages.alt: A quiet starry paper pattern introduces the first Star Rooms adventure.

pages.text:
High above the town stood the Tower of Star Rooms.

One bright morning, Mia opened its little blue door.
pages.alt: Mia steps into the warm tower at sunrise. A winding path leads towards the Star Door.

pages.text:
“Hello! I’m Tavi,” said the blue friend.

“And I’m Sol!” said the golden one. “Come and see our Star Door.”
pages.alt: Tavi waves to Mia while Sol points along the tower path towards the Star Door.

pages.text:
The three new friends followed the path together.

The Star Door was shut. It only opened when an adventure was ready.
pages.alt: Mia, Tavi and Sol arrive together and look up at the shut Star Door.

pages.text:
The door gave a tiny shake.

A note slid through its slot and landed by Mia’s hand.
pages.alt: Mia kneels beside a clearly labelled note while Tavi and Sol look at it.

pages.heading: Can you find the note?
pages.text: Point to the note Mia found.
pages.alt: A map emoji, a blue book emoji and a note emoji form three clear choices.

pages.text:
Mia picked it up and read aloud:

FIND NOTHING.
FIVE STARS WILL SHOW THE WAY.
pages.alt: Mia holds the note. Sol looks puzzled and Tavi leans closer to listen.

pages.text:
“Find nothing?” Sol scratched his head. “What does nothing look like?”

Five star shapes appeared. The first one pointed to a box.
pages.alt: The friends gather around a clearly labelled box on the rug. Five pale stars wait above it.

pages.text:
Sol opened the box.

“There’s my teddy!” he cheered.
pages.alt: A teddy emoji is visibly inside the box emoji while the friends look at it.

pages.heading: Help the teddy out
pages.text: Start at the teddy. Trace the gold path to the rug.
pages.alt: A curved gold finger trail leads from the teddy in the box to an open place on the rug.

pages.text:
The teddy sat on the rug. The box stayed where it was.

“The box is empty,” said Tavi. “The teddy is not inside it now.”
pages.alt: The empty box remains on the rug and the teddy is clearly outside it. One star shines.

pages.text:
The first star lit a path through a blue door.

The friends followed it into a round room.
pages.alt: Mia, Sol and Tavi enter the listening room and see Nori beside an empty bell stand.

pages.text:
A friend in a cap waved.

“I’m Nori. I like to listen carefully. Shall we try together?”
pages.alt: Nori welcomes Mia, Sol and Tavi beside a clearly labelled bell.

pages.text:
Nori rang the bell once.

DING!

Then everyone waited.
pages.alt: The bell is shown above the stand as the four friends listen to one ring.

pages.heading: Sound ... then quiet
pages.text: Ask a grown-up to clap once. Listen until the sound stops. Put your hands together when it is quiet.
pages.alt: Nori and the friends listen beside the still bell. Two stars shine.

pages.text:
The quiet bell was still there.

The next star led them to the paper room, where a card waited with no marks on it yet.
pages.alt: A plain white card emoji sits clearly on the empty table while all four friends look at it.

pages.heading: Mark it—or leave it
pages.text: On your own paper, make one mark or leave it as it is. Is the paper still there?
pages.alt: A blank card and a pencil sit apart on the table for a choose-and-compare activity.

pages.text:
“The card is still here,” said Mia.

“A card with no marks is blank. Blank does not mean gone.”
pages.alt: The blank card remains on the table. Three stars shine.

pages.heading: A word appears
pages.text: Point from left to right. Say each letter, then say the whole word.
pages.alt: Seven large letter tiles spell N O T H I N G from left to right. Four stars shine.

pages.text:
As they left, Sol’s teddy slipped from his bag.

Bump, roll, roll—it stopped behind a curtain.
pages.alt: The friends follow a trail to the closed curtain. The teddy has stopped at its edge.

pages.text:
Tavi closed the curtain.

Now they could not see the teddy.

“Did it go away?” asked Sol.
pages.alt: The teddy is out of sight behind the closed curtain while the four friends remember its path.

pages.heading: Where did it stop?
pages.text: Follow the little prints with your finger. Point to the place where the teddy is hiding.
pages.alt: A visible trail of small prints leads to the closed curtain for a memory and prediction game.

pages.text:
Tavi pulled the curtain slowly.

The curtain opened. There was the teddy!

“Hidden is not gone,” said Mia.
pages.alt: The teddy appears beside the curtain and is clearly labelled. All five stars shine.

pages.text:
All five stars flashed. The way opened with a happy click.

The friends stepped into a room with two matching shelves.
pages.alt: Mia, Sol, Tavi and Nori enter a room with two matching open shelf doorways.

pages.heading: Look at both shelves
pages.text: Point to the shelf with a card. Now point to the shelf with no card.
pages.alt: The left shelf holds one plain white card. The matching right shelf has no card.

pages.text:
“This shelf has a card,” said Sol.

“This shelf has no card,” said Tavi. “But both shelves are still here.”
pages.alt: The friends compare one shelf with a card and one shelf without a card.

pages.text:
Mia read the note again.

They had found empty, quiet, blank and hidden. They had not found a secret object called nothing.
pages.alt: Mia holds the note while the team smiles at the mystery they have solved.

pages.heading: Match the clues
pages.text: Trace each gold trail. Say the word at the end.
pages.alt: Four large emoji scenes connect by clear trails to the words empty, quiet, blank and hidden.

pages.heading: You solved it
pages.text:
You saw an empty box, a quiet bell, a blank card, a hidden teddy and a shelf with no card.

None was a secret thing called nothing. Clear words help people understand what really happened.
pages.alt: Mia, Sol, Tavi and Nori celebrate beside the finished five-star map.

pages.text:
Mia put the map in its stand. Nori waved goodbye.

Then a new parcel whooshed down the tower slide and stopped on the rug.
pages.alt: The tower delivery slide is clearly visible from its wall hatch to a new parcel on the rug. Nori waves goodbye.

pages.text:
Mia read the new question:

HOW CAN ONE WHOLE HAVE MANY PARTS?

Sol grinned. “Let’s find out!”
pages.alt: The three main friends gather around the new parcel as the next adventure begins.
